Your runs, with the detail behind them.\n\nConnect Garmin to bring your recent runs into Stride, including routes, splits and heart-rate detail. Stride checks Garmin for updates in the background and keeps a copy on this phone.

That does not look like a Garmin key. Copy the whole thing.
Garmin did not accept this key. Check that you copied the whole key, or create a new one in Garmin Connect. Your key has not been saved.
Connected. Stride is importing your runs and wellness now.
Disconnected. Your imported runs are still on this phone.
There is no browser on this phone to open Garmin.

Your key stays on this phone. Stride sends it directly to Garmin to get a short-lived access token, and never to Stride\'s servers. Garmin shows the key only once, so keep it private. You can remove it here or revoke it in Garmin Connect at any time.

An instance URL has to be https.
The Garmin key is entered in the Stride app, not in the browser. The setup screen has opened.
This phone connects with a Personal API key. It never asks for, and never stores, your Garmin password.
The phone connects with a Personal API key. There is no developer key here, and no OAuth client to use one with.
Garmin is not connected on this phone.
Your phone\'s credential was not given, so nothing was changed.
The phone is locked, so the key cannot be read. Unlock it and try again — your runs are still here.
This phone\'s key store was reset, so the saved Garmin key cannot be read. Connect Garmin again.
